insights.quote: The world changed in a very interesting way... The companies that began to list on Nasdaq back in the day were companies like Intel and Comcast, and eventually Apple... technology companies came to us because they were the disruptive, innovative, growth-oriented companies, some of who, back in that period of time, back in the 1970s and 80s, actually didn't qualify to list on the New York Stock Exchange.
insights.summary: Nasdaq blev hemvist för innovativa och tillväxtorienterade företag som inte kvalificerade sig för NYSE under 70- och 80-talen.
insights.speaker: Bob McCooey

insights.quote: When you think about what Nasdaq can provide to a company, it's this long-term partnership, and it's something that we've focused on over the past dozen years or so, which is what are the benefits of being listed with us? What are the services that we can provide to a company after their IPO? Because after they get through that magical event, you're back at your desk, and you have a whole brand new set of shareholders and a whole brand new set of challenges.
insights.summary: En börsnotering är början på ett långsiktigt partnerskap, inte bara en engångshändelse. Företaget står inför nya utmaningar efter noteringen.
insights.speaker: Bob McCooey

insights.quote: What an investor is looking for is they're investing in you as the management team. They're investing in your product, your growth opportunity, what the runway looks like. They're not investing in any way in deciding which exchange that you decide to list your stock on, because the markets here in the United States are really, really efficient.
insights.summary: Investerare fokuserar på företaget och dess ledning, inte på vilken börs aktien handlas på. Amerikanska marknader är mycket effektiva.
insights.speaker: Bob McCooey

insights.quote: Some of my colleagues like to refer to it as the courting process and then the IPO is being the wedding. So we want to talk them through that. You got to start dating first. And so you can't just show up the week before and say, I've got a date on the calendar for us to get married unless you've actually done all the work.
insights.summary: Förberedelse för börsnotering är en process som kräver tid och relationer, likt dejting innan ett bröllop.
insights.speaker: Bob McCooey

insights.quote: When we look at Nasdaq, we think of ourselves as a fintech company that runs exchanges rather than an exchange company. And our piece of the business, the piece of business I work in, the listings business, is only about 12 percent of Nasdaq's overall revenue.
insights.summary: Nasdaq har transformerat sig från en börs till ett fintech-bolag, med noteringar som endast 12% av intäkterna.
insights.speaker: Bob McCooey

summary: Sparpodden besöker Nasdaq i New York och intervjuar Bob McCooey, global head of capital markets, om den amerikanska IPO-marknaden. Avsnittet fokuserar på Nasdaqs historik, vilka företag som noteras där, fördelarna med att välja Nasdaq, samt trender i IPO-marknaden inklusive ökad aktivitet från kinesiska företag.
key_takeaways: Kinesiska IPOs på Nasdaq har ökat till 20 i år från 9 förra året
Nasdaq har vunnit 63% av alla IPOs i USA under 2017
Nasdaq är mer än en börs - ett fintech-bolag med diversifierade intäktströmmar
